text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon had finished running the 
Yayoi Sho, which also served as an 
opportunity for data collection.

Based on the race results, she muttered 
that she had to thoroughly prepare for the 
Satsuki Sho, and headed home.

Agnes Tachyon appears lost in thought. 
However, whatever was on her mind... was 
never revealed to her Trainer.
